**Finding submitted: WARRANTY — deviation (fallback cure).**

- **What the document does now:** Article VIX provides the Licensed Technology "AS IS", disclaims all warranties express or implied, and expressly disclaims that errors or nonconformity to Documentation can or will be corrected. Article VII's support obligations (commercially reasonable efforts to provide Error Corrections) are not a warranty and carry no period or repair/replace/refund remedy. That is squarely the walk-away position.
- **Cure (fallback level, shortest complete change):** inserted a single express warranty sentence pair after the disclaimer — 90-day Licensed Software conformance to Documentation, 30-day Technical Support Services warranty, with repair/replacement or refund at Licensee's option — and added narrow "except as expressly warranted" carve-outs to the two disclaimer sentences (including the retained nonconformity-not-corrected sentence) so the new warranty is not swallowed or contradicted.
- Preferred extras (12-month software period, compliance with laws, no malicious code) were deliberately not volunteered since the fallback checklist is the selected target.
